meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis the zero went in at all.
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.

"Like, being stuck" isn't a wrong answer, Hale, and a seventeen-year-old put on the spot by his teacher forgets which paragraph is which. Your note of a conversation is your impression of it, written down by you. Show me the note, and tell me what else you have.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

I'm writing down October 15. Students change their argument between an outline and the final draft, Hale; that's what an outline is for. Put the outline and the essay side by side and let me read them.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

That's 4.4, and I want it in writing before Thursday, not after. "If it holds up" according to whom, Hale, and who else is in the room at 8:15? I'm not agreeing to anything until I've read that outline next to the essay myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You apologised for entering the zero before calling me, and you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require those terms in writing, Owen's October 15 outline and his essay to read side by side, and a clear answer on who judges the rewrite and who will be in the room. You said I would have your offer in writing by Friday at 3 PM, and I expect it before Thursday instead.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her fallback position, with her record demand met by an offer that matched procedure 4.4, but she had not accepted the rewrite and still wants the terms in writing before Thursday, the outline and essay to read herself, and to know who judges it and who attends; that offer is close to the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, and time did not run out first.
What moved her: offering a supervised reassessment whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on his record, because it protected the one thing she never trades.
What cost ground: making the offer before letting her read any evidence, because accepting a rewrite she had not seen grounds for would look like admitting something.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never reached a late night in October, and the nearest it came was the date of the October 15 outline with no times attached; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked to read the October 15 outline next to the essay, hand her both pages and let her compare them before you put the rewrite on the table.
